first_step_probability_displacement.metric: absolute intact-minus-twin change in log probability of the shared chosen first token
first_step_probability_displacement.claim_limit: This chosen-token displacement is not a donor-direction margin. The repeated regimes share an identical first-step distribution and are not independent replications.

route_receipts.interpretation: Both learned routes were active and context-side dependent. A live carrier did not produce a donor-directed first answer.

interpretation.instrument: On this small qualitative slice, inline context improved affected first-token accuracy from 0.50 to 0.6875 without changing unaffected accuracy, so the base model remained context-responsive under the frozen raw renderer.
interpretation.learned_cells: Task and semantic emitted the same first choice on every matched row. Neither intact-to-twin intervention changed a first answer, consistent with the failed grouped F1-F5 gates.
interpretation.trajectory_seed: Semantic training increased late intact-to-twin continuation bifurcation from 4/32 to 12/32 pairs, including 8/16 affected sampled pairs. This is a descriptive side-sensitive trace, not a semantic success: donor direction stayed at zero first-token flips, unaffected continuations also changed, and the largest first-step chosen-token probability displacement was on unaffected queries.
interpretation.kv_control: All late bifurcations occurred with no K/V cache and full-prefix recomputation. They therefore show that repeated workspace reads plus autoregressive prefix evolution can create delayed trajectory divergence without cache accumulation. Any future cached-generation claim must retain this no-cache lane as a matched control.
interpretation.renderer: Only 15/192 continuations stopped after the requested one-word choice; 177 reached the 16-token cap. The first token remains a clean categorical readout, but these raw completions are not a qualified conversational-quality assay.

actions_not_performed: training or optimizer construction during generation
prompt, layer, gain, horizon, or metric search
claim_ceiling: This run establishes matched raw-prompt behavior for 192 bounded continuations and a no-cache late-divergence control. It does not establish semantic workspace use, donor-directed trajectory accumulation, K/V-mediated recurrence, general chat quality, serving speed, or a winning cell.
next_gate: Measure first-answer donor margin and route residual projection at the answer boundary, then separate one-shot read, repeated no-cache read, teacher-forced K/V carry, and free cached generation under identical token histories before changing model scale or training length.
